source: Independent source-informed runtime and declarations. Contract field names and original tests retain attribution; no upstream runtime copied and no clean-room claim.

implementation.targetScope: Custom static metadata on React function/class, memo and forward-ref wrappers; Emotion withTheme caller.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies; the two React wrapper tags are compared directly.
Own prototype-named custom statics are preserved safely.
Nearest descriptors are resolved before definition, preventing nonconfigurable ancestors from hiding child overrides.
Iterative traversal rejects proxy cycles; classification does not evaluate $$typeof accessors and never hoists that identity field.
Native Object/Function prototypes are not copied.

verification.runtime: 12 unchanged original tests and seven focused groups on Node24/Bun; the 12000-level original overflow is Node-specific.
verification.callers: Actual Emotion 11.14.0 withTheme and React 19.1.0 function/memo/forwardRef server renders.
verification.archives: Packed npm/Bun installations, CJS/ESM identity, browser bundle execution and TypeScript7 consumers without platform types.
verification.limits: Not a clone of arbitrary object graphs or hostile proxy traps. Unusual identity accessors and builtin-prototype copying intentionally differ; no browser frame-rate claim.
